title: Prompt caching silently does nothing: cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens stay 0
symptoms: usage.cache_creation_input_tokens: 0 and usage.cache_read_input_tokens: 0 on every call
No error although cache_control is set on the block
Parallel first requests all miss the cache
cause: A prefix shorter than the model's minimum cacheable length is processed uncached and no error is returned. The minimum differs by model: 512 tokens on the 5.x models, 1,024 on Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8, 2,048 on Opus 4.7, and 4,096 on Opus 4.6, Opus 4.5, and Haiku 4.5.
fix: Check both usage fields on the second identical call. If both are 0, grow the cached prefix past the model's minimum or move the breakpoint later. A cache entry exists only after the first response begins, so send one request and wait before fanning out.
apply:
const u = res.usage;
if (!u.cache_creation_input_tokens && !u.cache_read_input_tokens) console.warn('prompt not cached: prefix below the model minimum or breakpoint misplaced');
affected: Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, minimums as of 2026-10; Bedrock documents its own minimums
